## Theme

- [ ] Folder is `themes/<slug>/` and the payload is `<slug>.bbtheme`
- [ ] `meta.json` has a title, author, version, tags, gameVersion, and `license` `CC-BY-4.0`
- [ ] `README.md` explains the theme
- [ ] One preview image (`preview.png`, `.jpg`, or `.webp`)
- [ ] Tested in the game (Settings → Theme → Import)
- [ ] I have the right to share this under CC BY 4.0
- [ ] No real logos or trademarked art in the repo
- [ ] This pull request only touches `themes/<slug>/`
